line_01.speaker: MARA
line_01.text: Engineering hatch has no power. Communications, can you hear me? Inspect the maintenance cabinet beside your terminal.

line_02.speaker: MARA
line_02.text: Bypass secured. I’m heading to the shuttle. Echo Core shutdown is now available at Communications.

line_03.speaker: SAM
line_03.text: Mara is aboard. Still waiting for Medical and you.

line_04.speaker: IMANI
line_04.text: Eli is stable. We’re both aboard. Alex, come home.

line_05.speaker: ECHO
line_05.text: A usable auxiliary battery. Its isolated 20-unit circuit can power the Engineering hatch.

line_06.speaker: ECHO
line_06.text: Battery collected. Take it to the Engineering hatch socket.

line_07.speaker: MARA
line_07.text: Hatch is open. Come in. I can build a safe bypass for Medical.

line_08.speaker: MARA
line_08.text: Installing the bypass. Get oxygen from Docking to Imani while I work.

line_09.speaker: SAM
line_09.text: Portable oxygen collected. Imani can receive it through the Medical transfer port.

line_10.speaker: IMANI
line_10.text: Oxygen received. Eli is ready. We still need power for the door and transfer support.

line_11.speaker: ECHO
line_11.text: Echo Core offline. Forty units released. I’m still with you, Alex. There will be no further rewind.

line_12.speaker: ECHO
line_12.text: Medical door open. Route lighting: 20. Transfer support: 20. Ready for patient transfer.

line_13.speaker: IMANI
line_13.text: Moving Eli now. Keep the route powered. Meet us at the shuttle.

line_14.speaker: SAM
line_14.text: Alex aboard. Check the crew manifest before launch.
